notes: Exclusive mode only: when you press play, the device is Limpid's alone, and it stays Limpid's, paused or stopped, until you turn Device Lock off. Playing takes it again.
The same sound engine as in 1.0-74. Integer mode is each device's own switch, as you set it in 1.0-74.
Your library: search from every page, Artists, Folders as your folders keep them, and every page sorted as you choose (artist, title, release date or when you added the music). Each album shows once.
Music added to your folders comes into the library by itself, never while music plays.
Play Next, Play Later, Shuffle and Up Next.
Playlists, kept with your account on every computer you sign in on.
Limpid stays in the menu bar when its window closes, and the music plays on.
DSD and DXD are out for now. We're working on them.
Streaming services are coming. We're working on it.
